consequence.statement: If the gate is enabled, the ca-injector merges new CA certificates into the existing ones instead of outright replacing them.

original.statement: A new CAInjectorMerging feature gate is added to the ca-injector; when enabled, the injector merges new CA certificates instead of replacing the existing one.

decision.reason: [ev-e3729e495e40] describes a new opt-in feature gate. Enabling it makes the ca-injector merge in new CA certificates instead of replacing the existing one outright. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. The injector keeps working, just differently, so behavior-change (review) with low severity fits the stated condition, where the gate is enabled.
